abstract: Locally advanced pancreatic adenocarcinoma (LAPC) has a low resection rate (22%). In our prior phase II study, cancer vaccination (GVAX), pembrolizumab, SBRT and chemotherapy was associated with improved distant metastasis-free survival, but increased M2-like macrophages correlated with worse survival. In preclinical models, cysteine-cysteine chemokine receptors 2 (CCR2) and 5 (CCR5) blockade overcomes macrophage-driven resistance. We therefore initiated a phase I/II trial of nivolumab and BMS-813160 (CCR2/5 inhibitor) ± GVAX with FOLFIRINOX, SBRT, and surgery for LAPC. Primary endpoints were safety and changes in intratumoral CD137+CD8+ T cells which correlate with favorable survival. Twenty-two patients were treated; the remainder had disease progression during chemotherapy, withdrew consent, or did not meet eligibility prior to study treatment. In phase I (n=9), patients received nivolumab 480mg IV, GVAX 5x108 cells intradermal q4 weeks, and BMS-813160 150mg PO BID (DL1, n=3) or 300mg PO BID (DL2, n=6) with no dose limiting toxicities. In phase II (n=13), patients were randomized to nivolumab and BMS-813160 without (Arm A) or with (Arm B) GVAX; 3/5 patients (Arm A) and 8/11 patients (Arm B + DL2) achieved the primary immunologic endpoint. Fourteen patients had paired tumor biopsies with 13 showing >80% increase in CD137+CD8+ T cells meeting the primary immunology endpoint. Fourteen (64%) of 22 treated patients underwent R0/R1 resection which was numerically higher than historical LAPC data. In conclusion, adding nivolumab, BMS-813160, and GVAX to chemo-radiotherapy is tolerable and associated with favorable immunologic and clinical outcomes, though substantial attrition before study therapy limits definitive conclusions.
key_points_ko: 치료받은 환자 22명 중 14명(64%)이 R0/R1 절제술을 받았습니다.
치료를 받은 14명 중 13명에서 종양 내 CD137+CD8+ T 세포가 80% 이상 증가했습니다.
BMS-813160 용량 결정 과정에서 용량 제한 독성(DLT)은 관찰되지 않았습니다.
summary_ko: 국소 진행성 췌장암(LAPC) 환자를 대상으로 nivolumab(니볼루맙), BMS-813160(CCR2/5 억제제), GVAX, 항암화학요법 및 정위체부방사선치료(SBRT)를 병용하는 1/2상 임상시험을 진행했습니다. 총 22명의 환자가 치료를 받았으며, 1차 평가변수인 안전성과 종양 내 CD137+CD8+ T 세포의 변화를 평가했습니다. 치료받은 환자의 64%인 14명이 R0/R1 절제술을 받았습니다. 연구진은 해당 병용 치료가 안전하며 우수한 면역학적 및 임상적 결과와 연관이 있다고 결론지었습니다.
title: CCR2/5 antagonist with radiation and immunotherapy shows higher resectability for locally advanced pancreatic cancer and increased intratumoral CD8+CD137+ T cells
title_ko: 국소 진행성 췌장암에서 CCR2/5 길항제, 방사선 및 면역치료 병용 시 수술 가능성 및 종양 내 CD8+CD137+ T 세포 증가
